newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ispat Mexicana's 2001 bond seen good bet - Barings.
newsitem.headline: Ispat Mexicana's 2001 bond seen good bet - Barings.

text.p: Ispat Mexicana's 10-3/8 percent bond due March 2001 is a better buy than other Mexican Eurobonds with a similar maturity, said ING Barings in a report.

"They have done a really good job, and this is what the group is known for, buying companies that are in a distressed operational situation and turning them around," said ING Barings' head of Latin America Corporate Debt Research, Anne Milne.
The company said that at a spread of 433 basis points over U.S. Treasuries, the bond is trading 25 to 100 basis points wider than bonds with similar maturities.
"We believe that the bond can tighten to 350 basis points over (U.S. Treasuries) by year-end," it said.
Ispat Mexicana was purchased by the Ispat Group of India in 1992 from the Mexican government.
The company is Mexico's main producer of steel slabs.
